summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Qatar with a commanding 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing only to manage his Mercedes advantage across the final two races to secure the drivers' championship. The tight battle for third place between Lewis Hamilton and the duo of George Russell and Lando Norris adds intrigue, with Ferrari and McLaren fighting to maximize points ahead of Abu Dhabi. A conservative tyre strategy will define Qatar's race, with drivers limited to just 27 laps per set, making pit-stop timing and degradation management critical as Antonelli pursues the crown.
